policy.payout_formula: min(verified external income - realized loss - fee - prior user transfer, on-chain USDC - reserve, optional transaction cap)
policy.subcent_behavior: dust remains in the agent wallet

safety_contract.tenant_scope: one explicit uid and the same row's telegram_chat_id plus usable wallet destination
safety_contract.key_gate: protected key is opened only after policy returns a positive amount
safety_contract.authorization: deterministic EIP-3009 nonce per tenant payout evidence
safety_contract.facilitator: dedicated loopback port 8406; must advertise x402 v2 exact on eip155:8453
safety_contract.receipt: Base chain id 8453, status 0x1, and exactly one matching Circle USDC Transfer
safety_contract.ledger_order: financial_user_transfer is recorded after exact receipt verification and before Telegram

evidence_limit: The payout machine, reserve gate, tenant scoping, signing contract, receipt verifier, ledger order, and production zero-state path are proven. A real user payout, transaction hash, and Telegram receipt remain unproven until verified external surplus or a spec-approved seed makes the agent wallet exceed the $35 reserve.
